title: Entity-Conditioned Question Generation for Robust Attention Distribution in Neural Information Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating attention weights of the neural IR model's passage encoder over word-pieces corresponding to named entities, and measuring the entropy of token-level attentions to evaluate the uniformity of the model's attention distribution across all entities.
Comparing the average attention weights assigned to the first sentence of a passage against the average attention given to the remaining sentences to detect preferences for earlier text.
